title: Ma'an the Son of Zaidah and the Three Girls
logline: A thirsty prince out hunting is given water by three girls who never ask who he is; with no coins to thank them he gives away his thirty gold-tipped arrows, and the gift itself tells them his name.
moral: Kindness given without asking who it is for is answered by generosity, and a person is known by what he gives, not by his clothes or his company.
tone: Warm, sunny and gently comic for the first half (heat, empty waterskins, empty purses), a bright reveal in the middle, then lyrical and a little tender for the three verses; calm, glowing ending.

beats.summary: Prince Ma'an goes hunting with two men on a burning day, dressed as plainly as they are.
Deep in the desert the thirst bites.
The waterskins are empty: not enough even for the prince.
Three girls appear over a dune with full waterskins.
Without asking his name they give him water at once.
Refreshed, he wants to repay the kindness.
Nobody brought money on a hunt.
He thinks, then opens his quiver.
Ten each: thirty golden arrows instead of coins.
One girl works it out: only Ma'an bin Zaidah does this.
They thank him in verse; three pictured poems, the last one tender.
They knew him by his gift, not his clothes or attendants.
The arrows stay with the girls as a keepsake of the meeting.

sets.description: The planned desertRoad travel strip, used as open desert: world 2000 x 1230, ground line y 900. Sky: sky() day preset shifted pale (yellow-white near the horizon), large sun r 90 at (190,170). Three layers of flat dunes: far (crests y 700-740, pale yellow with red dot shading on the lee side), mid (crests y 780-820), and one FRONT dune lip from x 1450 to 2000 with its crest at (1560, 850) falling to the ground line at x 1450; the girls rise from behind this lip. One far palm at x 420 (scale 0.5, on the far dune) and one rock (120 x 70) at x 1750. Ground: sand ochre with sparse ripple strokes. Zone A (thirst) is x 0-800, zone B (meeting) x 900-1700. Late-afternoon option via skyCycle for the ending.

props.description: Goatskin water bag (qirba): brown rounded sack 78 x 50 with a short tied neck, four stub corners and a shoulder strap; fields fill 0..1 (round and taut to flat and creased), slosh, tilt, squeeze.
Leather quiver 36 wide x 118 tall with a flap lid (open 0..1), yellow trim band, strap; shows n red fletchings above the rim (n 0..30, drawn as up to 8).
Arrow 120 long: black-outlined pale shaft 5 thick, red two-vane fletching 22 long, leaf-shaped head 26 x 16 in process yellow with a white facet and red dot shading; glint option.
n arrows (1..10) held as a tight fan, heads up, tied with a red cord; built from goldArrow.
Simple recurve bow 150 tall: brown arc 7 thick and a thin string; worn across the back or held.
The planned drawstring purse (AN-095), here empty: limp brown pouch 40 x 46, open mouth, turned upside down.

subtitles.ar: خرج الأمير معن بن زائدة في يوم حار للصيد مع رجاله.|ابتعدوا في الصحراء، واشتد بهم العطش.|بحثوا عن الماء في أوعيتهم، لكنهم لم يجدوا ما يكفي حتى يشرب الأمير.
subtitles.en: The prince Ma‘an bin Zaidah went hunting on a hot day.|He and his men grew thirsty|and found no water to drink.

subtitles.ar: وبينما هم يسيرون، ظهرت ثلاث فتيات يحملن قربًا من الماء على أكتافهن.|اقترب منهن معن وطلب قليلًا من الماء.|لم يسألنه عن اسمه، بل قدمن إليه الماء فورًا.
subtitles.en: Three girls appeared carrying waterskins.|Ma‘an asked for a drink,|and without asking his identity they gave him water.

subtitles.ar: شرب معن حتى ذهب عطشه،|ثم أراد أن يشكر الفتيات على معروفهن.|التفت إلى رجاله وطلب مالًا ليعطيهن،|لكن الرجال لم يحملوا معهم نقودًا في رحلة الصيد.
subtitles.en: After drinking,|he wanted to repay their kindness.|He asked his men for money,|but they had brought none on the hunt.

subtitles.ar: فكر الأمير قليلًا، ثم فتح جعبة سهامه.|كانت رؤوس السهام مصنوعة من الذهب.|أعطى كل فتاة عشرة سهام،|فحصلت الفتيات الثلاث على ثلاثين سهمًا ثمينًا بدل النقود.
subtitles.en: The prince opened his quiver.|His arrows had golden tips,|so he gave each girl ten,|thirty valuable arrows in all.

subtitles.ar: نظرت الفتيات إلى السهام بدهشة.|قالت إحداهن لصاحبتَيها: «لا يفعل هذا إلا معن بن زائدة،|الذي يعرفه الناس بكرمه.|حتى سهامه التي يستعملها في الحرب تحمل الذهب!»
subtitles.en: The girls were astonished.|One said only Ma‘an,|famed for generosity,|would give away gold even from arrows used in war.

subtitles.ar: اتفقت الفتيات على أن تشكره كل واحدة بكلمات من الشعر.|أنشدت الأولى أبياتًا تصف رجلًا يجعل سهامه الذهبية عونًا للمحتاجين،|حتى عندما يخرج لملاقاة أعدائه في القتال.
subtitles.en: They decided to thank him in verse.|The first praised a warrior whose golden arrows could help|even those wounded in battle.

subtitles.ar: ثم أنشدت الثانية أبياتًا تقول إن الأمير يعطي بسخاء للأصدقاء والأعداء،|ولا يتوقف كرمه في أوقات الحرب.|أما الثالثة فوصفت كيف يمكن أن يدفع الذهب ثمن علاج المصاب|أو كفن الميت.
subtitles.en: The second praised his generosity|toward friends and enemies;|the third said the gold could pay for a wounded person’s treatment|or a dead person’s shroud.

subtitles.ar: استمع معن إلى ثناء الفتيات بعدما سقينه وهو عطشان.|عرفن هويته من هديته،|لا من ثيابه أو مرافقيه.|وبقيت السهام الذهبية معهن، ذكرى اللقاء في الصحراء.
subtitles.en: Ma‘an heard their praise after their kindness to him.|They had recognized him by his gift,|not his clothing or attendants.|The golden arrows remained with them as a memory of the meeting.

new_assets.name: desertRoad
new_assets.description: Open desert strip 2000 x 1230 with three dune layers, a front dune lip characters can rise from behind, a far palm, a rock and a hot pale sky. Reuses the planned desertRoad name (AN-044, AN-095); this film needs the plain open-desert option without city or wall.
new_assets.implementation: bake() three layers. Each dune layer is one closed path of 3-4 quadratic curves filled flat (far #f6e3a0, mid #edc65a, front sand ochre as ground()), with K halftone red dots clipped to the lee third. Draw order: sky, sun, far dunes, palm, mid dunes, girls while rising, FRONT lip, ground, everyone else. Options {palm, rock, lip, city:false}.

new_assets.name: waterskin
new_assets.description: Goatskin water bag with fill, slosh, tilt and squeeze, carried on a shoulder strap or held in two hands.
new_assets.implementation: One rounded blob path whose height scales 0.45..1 with fill and whose lower edge offsets by slosh; neck as a small trapezoid with a cord; crease strokes appear below fill 0.4; blue glint stroke when fill > 0.8. Strap is a line from the shoulder to the bag. Position from the carrier's P.hands or shoulder point.

new_assets.name: quiver + goldArrow (with arrowBundle and bow)
new_assets.description: Archer kit for any hunter or soldier story: quiver with opening flap and visible fletchings, a single arrow with an optional gold head and glint, a tied bundle of n arrows, and a simple bow. goldArrow with gold:false is an ordinary iron-headed arrow.
new_assets.implementation: Quiver: rounded rect + flap rotated about its top edge by open; fletchings are small red parallelograms above the rim. Arrow: line shaft, two fletch polygons, head as a 4-point leaf path filled C.yellow with a white triangle facet and halftone red on one side; glint = 4-point star scaled by pulse(). Bundle: n arrows rotated -12..12 degrees about a tie point. Bow: one quadratic arc stroke + string line.

new_assets.name: inset circle
new_assets.description: The planned round inset panel (8 other stories), used here as the verse picture: radius 230 (and one small one of 110), coloured dotted rim, iris open and close, linked to the reciter by three drifting note shapes instead of a thought trail.
new_assets.implementation: ctx.save, arc clip, draw the inner scene at its own scale and origin, restore, then a 10 px black ring and a ring of rim-colour dots. Radius animated by kfn for the iris. Notes are small filled ellipses with stems on bezier paths. If the planned inset circle is not built yet, thoughtCloud with a round shape and no trail is an acceptable stand-in.

new_assets.name: heatShimmer
new_assets.description: Hot-day cue: 3 to 5 thin wavy horizontal strokes rising slowly above the ground line plus a pulsing ring round the sun.
new_assets.implementation: Pure function of t: sine-offset polylines (K.noise seeded per line) at alpha 0.25 in white, y drifting up 40 px over 2 s and looping; sun ring radius = r * (1.15 + 0.05 sin(3t)).

new_assets.name: goldGlow
new_assets.description: The planned treasure light (KD-031): tapering yellow rays with a halftone disc and staggered star glints, strength 0..1; used on the arrowheads.
new_assets.implementation: As specified by KD-031: 9 triangles fanned about a point, a yellow halftone disc behind, 3 four-point stars on pulse() with offsets.

owner_questions: The hunting party is on foot with no horses or hawks (the Library has no horse, and the script says they were walking); default: on foot.
Ma'an wears a plain blue bedouin robe with no crown so that being recognised by his gift and not his clothing reads visually; default: plain costume.
The script does not number the men; default: two huntsmen.
The girls' three verses are shown as picture insets above each reciter (no verse text is written on screen, since the narration only describes them); default: picture insets.

Battle, wounding and death in the verses are softened: enemies are flat silhouettes with spears, the wounded man gets a clean bandage with no blood, and the shroud is a folded white cloth with a flower, no body; default: softened.

Added comic business not in the script: the single water drop that misses, the upside-down empty purse, the huntsman tripping on his bow at the end, girl3 tucking an arrow behind her ear; default: kept.

English lettering added: MA'AN, NO WATER!, WATER!, NO COINS!, GOLD!, counters 10 / 20 / 30 GOLDEN ARROWS, MA'AN BIN ZAIDAH!, FIRST / SECOND / THIRD, FRIEND / FOE, LATER..., THE END; default: kept (14 items, slightly above the usual 8 to 12).
The LATER... card is placed at 19.7 s between the search for water and the walk on, although the Arabic says 'while they were walking'; default: card kept, since the film needs one passage of time.
implementation_notes: World 2000 x 1230, ground y 900; the camera clamps as in the template with WW = 2000. All camera keys in the scene notes are {x, y, zoom} for K.camAt; hold with paired keys and ease on beat boundaries.

Final standing positions (feet, y 900): zone A Ma'an 700, man1 600, man2 490. Zone B Ma'an 1180 then 1300 from 30.9, man1 1150 (1040 before 29), man2 1050 (940 before 29), girl1 1430, girl2 1530, girl3 1630. In the verse scenes the reciter steps forward to x 1400-1410 and back.
Set LIFE.t = t every frame for auto-blinks; give each character a seed. Suppress blinks (noBlink) in the 0.8 s shared stare at 84.0-84.9 and the look to camera at 90.6-91.1.

Every walk uses a position function + walk() + footfalls() so no foot slides; the three men and the three girls never share a phase (offset by 0.35 of a cycle) and reactions use stagger(i) of 3 to 5 frames.

Girls rising over the dune: draw them before the FRONT dune lip layer and move them along the path (1760,960) to (1560,850) to their marks; switch them to the normal layer once past the crest (after 27.9).

Carried props follow the carrier: waterskin at shoulder (local about (-34,-150)), quiver on the back (local (26,-150), rotated 0.25) until 63.4 then at the hip front (local (-20,-95)); use P.hands for held items.

Verse insets: centre world (1380,330), radius 230, drawn after the world and before lettering; inner scenes are small functions vInset1/2/3(ctx, t) in their own 460 x 460 space with ground at y 380 and figures at s 0.5-0.55. Rim colours yellow, red, blue. Only one inset is open at a time.
Counter and icon rows are drawn in panel space (not world) so the camera cannot crop them: counter top-right at panel (820,150); S15 icon row at y 380-470.
Panel-only shake is not needed in this film; there are no hits.

Sound (SND master 0.6, offline render, amix normalize=0): whoosh 6.6, pop 11.6 (the drop), whoosh 20.0 (LATER card), pop 59.8, chime 60.4 (the idea), chime 85.0, pop 87.8, chime 121.7 (verse change), chime 165.5 (THE END). All are inside listed pauses or after the last word. The gold reveal at 69.22 has no effect because there is no pause there.
Subtitle chunks are in 'subtitles' (verbatim, '|' marks). P7 has four chunks where the English and Arabic phrase boundaries differ slightly in the first half; time chunks by the Arabic words.
Lettering never covers a face: name labels above heads, sound words in the gap between groups, THE END at y 330.

Reuse first: person presets bedouin, villageWoman, villager, physician; PERSON_HANDS gestures; sun, sky, skyCycle, ground, dustBurst, heart, cloud. New drawings go in the story's src first and move to Library/ after approval with registry entries.
warnings: Three near-identical villageWoman figures can blur together at phone size: keep the three robe colours (red, blue, green), the three heights and the three temperaments distinct in every scene.
Scenes S12 to S14 are 36 s of recited verse with little physical action in the script; the insets must keep changing every 1 to 2 s or the film will stall here.
The inset figures are small: keep each at least 110 px tall on screen and limit each inset to three figures.
The person figure is front-facing only: turning to walk away (S16) and facing the men (S6) rely on dir and turnFlip; check the walk-away reads as leaving.
desertRoad, inset circle, goldGlow, purse and coinPile are planned by other stories but not built; whichever film is produced first must build them to the shared specification.
Word starts in the timeline can lead the audible onset by up to 0.4 s; check the gold reveal (69.22) and the name (90.56) against the audio by ear.
